units.source_text: 此答诗随口吟出，并不足观。

en.t: This reply poem was composed offhand and is not worth much attention.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧本拟轻装简从，悄悄前往，但这里的人都希望随行。

en.t: The younger nun had originally planned to travel quietly with only a small retinue, but everyone here wanted to go along.

units.source_text: 因此留在家里的人甚少。

en.t: As a result, very few people were left at home.

units.source_text: 她怕浮舟寂寞，派能干的尼僧少将和另一名叫左卫门的年长侍女留着陪伴她，此外只有几个女童。

en.t: Afraid that Ukifune would be lonely, she left the capable nun Shosho and another older attendant named Saemon to keep her company, along with only a few young girls.
